visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit, spacious restaurant interior featuring wooden tables, dark-framed chairs, and large windows revealing lush green trees and urban buildings outside. Numerous spherical paper lanterns with black calligraphy hang from the ceiling. (2) A female staff member wearing a pink polo shirt, face mask, and glasses pushes a service cart through the aisle. A close-up shot follows, showing a white bowl filled with square, textured crackers being held up by a hand. (3) The camera focuses on a sequence of plated dishes: a steamed fish garnished with yellow seeds, onions, and red chili; a bowl of braised beef with thick sauce; and various side sets containing white rice, seaweed soup with corn, and small appetizers. (4) A hand holds a tall yellow paper cup featuring the 'Keng Tu Yuan' logo. This is followed by shots of dry noodles topped with julienned cucumbers and a large bowl of beef noodles with broccoli and a boiled egg. (5) Close-ups depict a bowl of golden sweet potato balls and a black sesame steamed bun being torn apart to reveal a dark, flowing filling. Additional small plates of fried tofu and blood cake are shown. (6) A detailed process shot shows hands in blue gloves rolling and cutting a translucent white dessert (Osmanthus cake) on a surface covered in yellow powder. (7) The visual transitions to a traditional tea set on a wooden tray where water is poured into a reddish-brown clay teapot, followed by tea being poured into small white porcelain cups. (8) The video concludes with a slow pan across the empty restaurant seating area and a final shot of a red wooden signboard with gold-leaf calligraphy hanging above an entrance.
